import base64, ctypes as c, io, os, shutil, subprocess, time
from pathlib import Path
from PIL import Image
from pywinauto import Desktop
from pywinauto.keyboard import send_keys
import psutil

ROOT=Path(r"C:\dev\flyExplorer")
EXE=ROOT/"out"/"winui"/"Release"/"flyExplorer.exe"
PROFILE=Path(os.environ["USERPROFILE"])
TARGETS=("Desktop","Documents","Downloads","Pictures","Music","Videos")

def until(fn,why,timeout=25):
    end=time.monotonic()+timeout
    last=None
    while time.monotonic()<end:
        try:
            v=fn()
            if v:return v
        except Exception as e:
            last=e
        time.sleep(.25)
    raise AssertionError(f"{why}; last={last!r}")

def shot_b64(wrapper):
    img=wrapper.capture_as_image().convert("RGB")
    img.thumbnail((972,720))
    buf=io.BytesIO()
    img.save(buf,format="JPEG",quality=82,optimize=True)
    return base64.b64encode(buf.getvalue()).decode("ascii")

def match_target(name):
    low=name.lower()
    for t in TARGETS:
        tl=t.lower()
        if name==t or low.startswith(tl+" ") or ("["+t.lower()+"]" in low):
            return t
        # flyExplorer accessible row names may include folder label after filename.
        if low.startswith(tl+" |") or low.startswith(tl+" [") or low.startswith(tl+","):
            return t
    return None

def collect_rows(root):
    found={}
    allnames=[]
    for item in root.descendants():
        try:
            if item.element_info.control_type!="ListItem": continue
            name=(item.element_info.name or item.window_text() or "").strip()
            if not name: continue
            allnames.append(name)
            t=match_target(name)
            if t and t not in found: found[t]=(item,name)
        except Exception: pass
    return found,allnames

owned=ROOT/"logs"/"known-folder-artwork-owned"
if owned.exists(): shutil.rmtree(owned)
(owned/"localappdata"/"flyExplorer").mkdir(parents=True)
(owned/"appdata").mkdir(); (owned/"temp").mkdir()
(owned/"localappdata"/"flyExplorer"/"ui-preferences-v1.txt").write_text(
    "schema=2\r\nlanguage=ko-KR\r\ntheme=dark\r\nview=large-icons\r\n",
    encoding="ascii",newline="")
env=os.environ.copy()
env["LOCALAPPDATA"]=str(owned/"localappdata")
env["APPDATA"]=str(owned/"appdata")
env["TEMP"]=env["TMP"]=str(owned/"temp")
proc=subprocess.Popen([str(EXE),str(PROFILE)],cwd=EXE.parent,env=env)
appspec=None
try:
    def app_spec():
        ws=[w for w in Desktop(backend="uia").windows(process=proc.pid) if "flyExplorer" in w.window_text()]
        return Desktop(backend="uia").window(handle=ws[0].handle) if len(ws)==1 else None
    appspec=until(app_spec,"flyExplorer window missing")
    appwrap=appspec.wrapper_object()
    try: appwrap.move_window(x=40,y=40,width=972,height=720,repaint=True)
    except Exception: pass
    pane=appspec.child_window(auto_id="LeftFiles").wrapper_object()
    found,names=until(lambda:(lambda z:z if len(z[0])>=6 else None)(collect_rows(pane)),
                      "flyExplorer Known Folder rows incomplete",30)
    print("FLY_ALL_LIST_ITEMS_BEGIN",flush=True)
    for n in names[:80]: print("FLY_ITEM",repr(n),flush=True)
    print("FLY_ALL_LIST_ITEMS_END",flush=True)
    print("FLY_KNOWN_FOLDER_COUNT",len(found),flush=True)
    for t in TARGETS:
        item,name=found[t]
        imgs=[]
        for x in item.descendants():
            try:
                if x.element_info.control_type=="Image":
                    imgs.append(x.element_info.name or "")
            except Exception: pass
        known=[x for x in imgs if x=="Windows Known Folder artwork"]
        r=item.rectangle()
        print("FLY_KNOWN_FOLDER_ROW",t,repr(name),r.left,r.top,r.width(),r.height(),
              "KNOWN_ARTWORK",len(known),"IMAGES",repr(imgs),flush=True)
    print("FLY_SCREENSHOT_BEGIN",flush=True); print(shot_b64(appwrap),flush=True); print("FLY_SCREENSHOT_END",flush=True)
finally:
    if proc.poll() is None:
        try:
            c.windll.user32.PostMessageW(appspec.wrapper_object().handle,0x10,0,0)
            proc.wait(timeout=10)
        except Exception:
            proc.terminate(); proc.wait(timeout=8)
print("FLY_PROCESS_EXIT",proc.returncode,flush=True)

# Explorer comparison.
before=set()
for w in Desktop(backend="uia").windows(control_type="Window"):
    try:
        if psutil.Process(w.element_info.process_id).name().lower()=="explorer.exe": before.add(w.handle)
    except Exception: pass
subprocess.Popen(["explorer.exe","/separate,",str(PROFILE)])
expspec=None
try:
    def exp_spec():
        for w in Desktop(backend="uia").windows(control_type="Window"):
            try:
                if w.handle in before: continue
                if psutil.Process(w.element_info.process_id).name().lower()=="explorer.exe":
                    return Desktop(backend="uia").window(handle=w.handle)
            except Exception: pass
        return None
    expspec=until(exp_spec,"new Explorer window missing",20)
    expwrap=expspec.wrapper_object()
    try: expwrap.move_window(x=40,y=40,width=972,height=720,repaint=True)
    except Exception: pass
    expwrap.set_focus(); send_keys("^+2"); time.sleep(1.5)
    efound,en=until(lambda:(lambda z:z if len(z[0])>=6 else None)(collect_rows(expwrap)),
                    "Explorer Known Folder rows incomplete",20)
    print("EXPLORER_KNOWN_FOLDER_COUNT",len(efound),flush=True)
    for t in TARGETS:
        item,name=efound[t]
        r=item.rectangle()
        print("EXPLORER_KNOWN_FOLDER_ROW",t,repr(name),r.left,r.top,r.width(),r.height(),flush=True)
    print("EXPLORER_SCREENSHOT_BEGIN",flush=True); print(shot_b64(expwrap),flush=True); print("EXPLORER_SCREENSHOT_END",flush=True)
finally:
    if expspec is not None:
        try: expspec.wrapper_object().close()
        except Exception: pass
